summary: Accept as test-only hardening. The recorded base already contains the production fix; the candidate adds focused regression coverage without changing source. Exact candidate tests and independent shape/value probes confirm that active-EP scattered hidden and residual rows are aligned to full positions before LongCat self_attn[1].

tests.what_was_measured: The exact candidate's five focused tests passed: active-EP gather, controlled legacy RoPE mismatch, no-backend and TP=1 boundaries, and gather/rank-slice values.
Using the checkout's real _scmoe_align_rows, TP=4 active EP gathered hidden and residual from 1 to 4 rows with exact expected values before attention; disabled EP made no collective call.
On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, reproduced the original invalid view from 256 scattered elements and validated the aligned (16, 4, 64) tensor with max_abs_error=0.
Focused formatting, lint, spelling, AST, and registered-test checks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: A deterministic tensor probe ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, architecture gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, reproduced the reported legacy reshape failure, and validated aligned output numerically.

remaining_limitations: The recorded base already contains the source fix, so failing-before was demonstrated by disabling only the alignment helper rather than by claiming the recorded base fails.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; the original 4x H200 TP16/EP16 PD-disaggregated DeepEP deployment was not available.
LongCat-2.0-FP8 weights were unavailable, so full serving behavior and semantic accuracy were not tested.
No live multi-rank DeepEP/UCCL collective was executed; the review validates the shape/dataflow contract with deterministic collective substitution.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
